claims.text: Company admins can use the Protected Microsoft 365 Objects report to monitor efficiency of M365 data protection
Integration requires VB365 v6+, reporting/jobs/restore require v7+
Report examines whether protected M365 objects are compliant with the SLA target
Covers users, groups, sites and teams meeting/breaching target SLA
Details section lists object name, restore points, job name/destination, successful sessions, server, SLA %, schedule in UTC
VSPC sends reports by email as PDF attachments, manually or on a schedule

A.notes: All claims supported; omits the requirement of at least one managed Veeam product.

claims.text: VSPC provides the Protected Microsoft 365 objects report to monitor efficiency of VB365 protection
Report analyzes whether M365 objects are compliant with SLA target
Report examines SLA compliance for Users, Groups, Sites and Teams [5]
Report Details shows backup status, restore points, successful sessions, SLA %, schedules
Integration with VB365 available starting from VSPC version 6.0
VB365 provides detailed reports as email attachments for backup jobs
VB365 provides User Protection reports on protected/unprotected users
VB365 provides Mailbox Protection Reports

B.notes: Citations [1] and [5] point at an invoices/licensing passage that supports nothing; gives a VSPC version instead of the VB365 version requirement; no VSPC email/PDF delivery.

claims.text: With DHCP, Veeam Agent configures network settings automatically; nmtui to verify/configure manually
Select Configure network in Recovery Media main menu
Edit a connection in NetworkManager to add/modify
Activate new connection; modified connection must be deactivated then activated
Press Esc to return to main menu
Mount shared folder step appears for backups in a network shared folder
Select SMB (CIFS) share type
Path in SERVER/DIRECTORY format
Provide domain, username and password of account with access permissions
Share mounted to /media of the recovery image OS file system
Several shared folders can be mounted via Add shared folder; name, type, mount point shown
Veeam Agent mounts SMB shared folders to /media of the recovery image OS file system
Recovery Media supports adding a network shared folder via 'Add shared folder'
The only Mount Shared Folder dialog described is for NFS, not SMB; SMB settings are not specified

B.notes: Misses networking entirely and wrongly says SMB mount settings are not described although its own source [1] lists domain/username/password.
